description: Resizable dropdown panels in Svelte 5. SvDropDownList, SvComboBox and SvAutoComplete detect the browser bounds, opening downward when there is room and flipping upward near the window edge, and a resizable prop adds a bottom drag grip to the open panel: drag to grow or shrink the list, the height sticks for the session and the grip hides on an upward flip. A switch compares fixed-height and resizable panels in light and dark themes.
keywords: svelte 5 dropdown flip up near edge

faq.question: How does the panel decide to open upward?
faq.answer: On open it measures the space below the trigger in the viewport; if the panel would not fit it opens above, and it re-checks on scroll and resize.

faq.question: How do I enable resizing?
faq.answer: Add resizable to the picker. A grip appears at the bottom of the open panel; the chosen height is remembered for that picker until the page is reloaded.

faq.question: Why does the grip disappear when flipped?
faq.answer: A panel that opened upward has no room to grow downward, so the grip is hidden to avoid a drag that could not do anything.
